title: Making Clinical Language Models Auditable: Concept-Guided Fine-Tuning for Robust Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2608.27397v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Clinical language models can achieve strong in-hospital accuracy yet fail under deployment shifts because they exploit note-specific artifacts (e.g., templates, separators, boilerplate) that do not reflect patient state. We propose CAST (Concept-guided Artifact Suppression Tuning), an SAE-based framework for auditable clinical text classification. CAST uses Sparse Autoencoders to expose sparse, human-auditable features from intermediate Transformer activations, labels SAE latents with an LLM-assisted interpretation pipeline and ICD-10 retrieval constraints, suppresses verified artifact latents via residual subtraction during fine-tuning, and provides post-hoc per-concept attributions for auditing model decisions. translated_title: 使临床语言模型可审计：概念引导的微调以实现稳健预测
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.27397v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：临床语言模型在院内预测中可以达到较高准确性，但在部署环境变化下会失效，因为它们利用了不反映患者状态的笔记特定伪影（如模板、分隔符、样板文本）。我们提出了CAST（概念引导伪影抑制调优），一种基于SAE的可审计临床文本分类框架。CAST使用稀疏自编码器从中间Transformer激活中提取稀疏、人类可审计的特征，通过LLM辅助解释流程和ICD-10检索约束标记SAE潜在变量，在微调期间通过残差减法抑制已验证的伪影潜在变量，并提供事后逐概念归因以审计模型决策。在MIMIC-IV出院记录死亡率预测中，CAST相对于相应的微调编码器基线有所改进，并与强大的LLM基线保持竞争力，同时生成临床特征级别的审计轨迹。
tldr: 本文提出CAST框架，通过稀疏自编码器暴露并抑制临床语言模型中的笔记伪影，实现可审计且稳健的预测，优于微调编码器并与LLM基线竞争。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CAST, a framework that uses sparse autoencoders to expose and suppress note-specific artifacts in clinical language models, enabling auditable and robust prediction, outperforming fine-tuned encoders and remaining competitive with LLM baselines.
